root_cause.text: The GET_INSTANCE_ID macro in the hp-bioscfg driver iterates over an array of data structures without checking if `attr_name_kobj` is NULL before dereferencing its `name` field, and uses an off-by-one loop condition (`<=` instead of `<`) that can cause out-of-bounds access, leading to a null pointer dereference when reading sysfs attributes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check for `attr_name_kobj` and corrects the loop boundary from `<=` to `<`. The CVE description and panic trace confirm a null-ptr-deref in `min_length_show`, which uses the macro to find the instance by comparing `kobj->name` to `attr_name_kobj->name`.
